01_seed_operator_grammar.png.alt: Six-step route: choose seeds, address them, apply operators, record relations, form the hull and reconstruct. Packet projection is optional.

02_transfer_block_norms.png.alt: Three-by-three heatmap of transfer-block norms. Rows select the output packet and columns select the input packet; values range from 5.0 to 8.1.

03_cyclic_rank_profiles.png.alt: Two rank profiles for a fixed seed in eight dimensions: one reaches rank eight, while the other stops at rank four.

04_semisimple_seed_rank.png.alt: Seed-rank heatmap for simple-module dimension d and multiplicity m. Each value is the ceiling of m divided by d.

05_path_graph_seed_rank.png.alt: Path graphs with two through twenty vertices each have seed rank one; the drawing marks an endpoint seed.

06_cycle_graph_seed_rank.png.alt: Cycle graphs with three through twenty vertices each have seed rank two under the stated complex adjacency assumptions.

07_shift_packet_transfer.png.alt: Six-packet shift: 0 to 1 to 2 to 3 to 4 to 5 to 0. The matrix has one nonzero transfer block in each row and column.

08_elliptic_packet_transfer.png.alt: Multiplication by y exchanges the even and odd packets: even to odd has weight 1; odd to even has weight x cubed minus x.

09_coordinate_transport.png.alt: Heatmap of products of transported projectors. Diagonal norms are 12.16, 16.02 and 17.31; off-diagonal norms are about ten to the minus fourteen from roundoff.

10_theorem_dependency.png.alt: Two theorem routes: generator grammar leads through hulls to bounds; packet projectors lead through coordinates to transport. Both feed worked realizations.
